customers.evidence: We are a fiduciary to our clients

employees.evidence: Culture inspires employees to go above and beyond their responsibilities every day

integrity.evidence: a set of principles that ensure we never forget what we stand for

innovation.evidence: We are proud of our long history of innovation, driving continuous change to help investors achieve their goals.

result.analyst_notes: Short declarative headlines in first-person plural, aspirational and confident, with no hedging. Clients are addressed first, via the fiduciary headline and 'your goals are our goals'. Employees and culture follow, partly through a CEO quote in first person. Innovation is framed as a long-standing identity. Concrete commitments and measurable targets are absent; the page speaks in principles rather than specifics.
